'''Phyll''' was an individual of a [[Plant/Legends|plant]]-like [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Phyll played [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] with [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] during his visit on [[Rafa IV]], in [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]]. In order to be understood in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], they employed an [[electronic synthesiser]] that poorly translated their speech in real-time.<ref name="sharu" />
